After detecting 1001 in S4, the FSM returns to IDLE, so an overlapping sequence such as 1001001 produces only one detection
After S4, the FSM transitions to S1 or equivalent so the final 1 can start a new sequence, producing two detections for 1001001
On any non-matching bit, the FSM resets to IDLE, so a later valid sequence is missed if it depended on a suffix of the mismatched stream
On a non-matching bit, the FSM transitions to the longest-suffix state, so inputs like 11001 still detect 1001
sequence_detected is forced low while rst_n is low, either directly or because the state is IDLE
